name: Madison River (Upper)
gaugeName: Madison at Kirby Ranch nr Cameron
blurb: The 50-mile riffle. Drift-boat water from Lyons Bridge to Ennis — fast, shallow, and famous.

sections.notes: Float fishing starts at Lyons. Steady riffle, big views, beginner-friendly half day.
sections.routeReview: General Madison River course only. Shore connections, present bridge passages and the navigable channel are not mapped. Retain the documented access-area markers and existing planning distance; inspect the actual landing and current conditions.

putInAccess.note: Boating access is documented by the managing agency. The unchanged agency coordinate identifies the facility/parking or bridge-access area, not a surveyed ramp edge. Kept as an approximate area marker; exact shore connections and the downstream bank are not verified.
putInAccess.directions: Use the signed Lyons Bridge Fishing Access Site and its concrete ramp. The agency marker locates the access facility; follow the internal approach rather than treating the marker as the water edge.

takeOutAccess.note: Boating access is documented by the managing agency. The unchanged agency coordinate identifies the facility/parking or bridge-access area, not a surveyed ramp edge. Kept as an approximate area marker; exact shore connections and the downstream bank are not verified.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use the separate Palisades day-use boat-access site near the campground, on the west side of US Highway 287 about 25 miles south of Ennis. Follow the facility approach to the paved launch; the published coordinate is a facility marker.

sections.notes: Ruby Creek campground is an optional midway takeout. Classic upper-Maddy water.

sections.notes: Full-day riffle. Gradient eases a little; still few eddies. Wind can howl.
